data.title: Black Friday: Ignite the Battlefield with Discounts!
data.meta_title: Black Friday: Ignite the Battlefield with Discounts!
data.content:
The Black Friday strike has hit the frontier, Pilots! From November 25 to December 1, gear up, upgrade your arsenal, and seize 30% off bundles and faction-themed cosmetics. The battlefield awaits — will your mech rise to dominate?

Make sure to read till the end — there’s a special gift waiting just for you!

30% Off Bundles

Anansi Chassis Bundle

  • 3x Anansi Chassis (War Robot Module)
  • 45,000 Salvage

30% Off Cosmetics

Upgrade your mech’s look with the latest faction-themed skins, wraps, and decals!

Pyroclast Animated Wrap

This living paint radiates the embers of Ferus Mons volcano, yet feels almost freezing to the touch.

Stormbond Animated Wrap

Shimmering streaks of indigo and silver arc across its surface. Pilots swear they can hear thunder when they reach for it.

FortEvo Customization Bundle

  • Eclipse Wrap. Colors of FortEvo's elite operatives. Worn by Mitosis, dominion's head of tactical planning in the Wild Ten.
  • FortEvo Livery Decal. FortEvo encourages the belief that there is a message in this image visible only to their agents.    
  • FortEvo Lava Sticker. Lava lamps are very FortEvo.

Freecon Customization Bundle

  • Boreal Wrap. Freecon's Discovery Corps turn all their missions into marketing opportunities. This wrap was released to commemorate the loss of one of their polar expeditions. 
  • Freecon Stars Sticker. A channel ident for one of the top three broadcast entertainment conglomerates on Mars.
  • Freecon Livery Decal. Standardized dominion ident, as per Freecon Forces Regulations.    

30% Off Pilots

Hero and Common pilots are also available for hire at a Black Friday discount!

  • Hero Pilot Ever.

  • Common Pilot Continuum.

Your Black Friday Gift

You made it! As a token of appreciation, here’s your exclusive promo code: SINGULARITYDEAL — redeem it to receive a 3-Day Premium and 5000 Salvage for free!

Act fast — this gift is only available during the Black Friday event (November 24–December 1).

All items will be discounted on the website and on Steam until December 1.

Happy shopping, Pilots!

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

PlayStation®5 │PlayStation®4 │ Xbox Series X|S™ │Xbox One™ 

Steam │ MY.GAMES Launcher

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
